This document outlines the maintenance procedure P1, which must be performed 
on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The technical specification of the turbine P max = 1.8 MW, H max = 5.5m, 
Q = 50m3/s, D = 3600 mm, speed = 90.58/1000 RPM,

The 
first draft initiated by eng. Abd El Mohsen Mohamed, tested at Nag Hammadi 
Hyd. PS, and certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Halem: HPGC MPIS coordinator, QC 
general director.

items:
A work permit must be issued and qualified maintanance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category

Wear the safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, shoes, 
 gloves etc
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Stop the unit and CB out, and earthing transformer
Hang the suitable warning boards
Put the up stream stop logs and dewatering the spiral case
Select the unit on manual mode and operate governor pump continuously
Open 100% wicket gate and put the safety pin in panel rack
Safety helmet and safety shoes
Set of wrenches, cleaning material
Alignment equipment
Grease for lubricating (multi purpose grease, Kaplan turbine)
Lifting manual crane

Carryout the semi 
 annual inspection as MPIS doc # Turb-002-r0

Check and cleaning 
 any leakage from the gear box and governor cooler

Check runner and 
 guide vanes surface for bad painting and crakes

Check the guide 
 vanes and runner clearance and compare with commissioning values

Comparing the 
 closing and opening time of servomotor

Check the sealing 
 and bolts for the inspection turbine doors

Check the 
 dewatering spiral casing valve

Check the protection 
 and control equipment

Introduction
This document outlines the maintenance procedure P1, which must be performed 
on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The technical specification of the turbine P max = 1.8 MW, H max = 5.5m, 
Q = 50m3/s, D = 3600 mm, speed = 90.58/1000 RPM,
The 
first draft initiated by eng. Abd El Mohsen Mohamed, tested at Nag Hammadi 
Hyd. PS, and certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Halem: HPGC MPIS coordinator, QC 
general director.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and qualified maintanance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Wear the safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, shoes, 
 gloves etc
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Stop the unit and CB out, and earthing transformer
Hang the suitable warning boards
Put the up stream stop logs and dewatering the spiral case
Select the unit on manual mode and operate governor pump continuously
Open 100% wicket gate and put the safety pin in panel rack
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet and safety shoes
Set of wrenches, cleaning material
Alignment equipment
Grease for lubricating (multi purpose grease, Kaplan turbine)
Lifting manual crane
Work to be Carried Out
Carryout the semi 
 annual inspection as MPIS doc # Turb-002-r0
Check and cleaning 
 any leakage from the gear box and governor cooler
Check runner and 
 guide vanes surface for bad painting and crakes
Check the guide 
 vanes and runner clearance and compare with commissioning values
Comparing the 
 closing and opening time of servomotor
Check the sealing 
 and bolts for the inspection turbine doors
Check the 
 dewatering spiral casing valve
Check the protection 
 and control equipment
